newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Spot prices mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Spot prices mostly higher.

text.p: Spot millfeed values were mostly higher Wednesday, supported by a tightness of nearby supply as the coming holidays bear down on the market, several dealers said.
"There are no bids and lots of buyers," a Minneapolis dealer said. there is a definite shortage of millfeeds.
One Texas dealer noted increased merchant feed usage and a shortness of nearby supply. But it was quiet, he said.
In the northeast, ample feed was available. "We are kind of lagging in the market from the rest of the country," he said.
In the Carolinas, people have bought a few loads to make sure they are covered. "There is demand from the feedmixers," a Carolinas dealer said.
Carolinas spot values stood at $102 a ton on the bid side and $104 on the offer side, up $3.00.
